title: Masoud Pezeshkian: BRICS should create a space where no country can disrupt the legitimate trade of other countries.
text:
Masoud Pezeshkian: BRICS should create a space where no country can disrupt the legitimate trade of other countries."

"Iran President, at the BRICS Economic Forum:"

"🔸First, I would like to thank India for their efforts in strengthening the BRICS community."

"🔸Today, the world is at one of its most complex junctures; the increasing use of economic tools to exert economic pressure has put the legitimate trade of other countries at risk."

"🔸What is BRICS' response to these problems?"

"🔸The power of BRICS will become more evident when it moves from potential cooperation to practical cooperation."

"🔸Iran has faced extensive sanctions in recent years; these pressures have entered a new phase in the past year following the aggression of the United States and Israel."
